purpose: Narrow hobby-level fix revalidation: the five new hobby_overrides_v1.json entries (business.fire_movement, arts.comedy_writing, arts.calligraphy, arts.zine_making, arts.hip_hop_dance) address the five remaining narrow Batch-1/final-hygiene-round blockers. This is not a new category-level policy - each fix is scoped to exactly one hobby.
fixes_under_test: business.fire_movement hobby override: unlabeled financial-planning props, explicit forbidden sticky-note words list
arts.comedy_writing hobby override: thesaurus/dictionary prop removed structurally, not just blanked
arts.calligraphy hobby override: abstract/partial/gestural brush strokes required, no hanging wall scrolls, semantic exception that brushwork itself is required but must not form readable text
arts.zine_making hobby override: plain studio wall / blank corkboard background, no posters/flyers/wall typography
arts.hip_hop_dance hobby override: generic unbranded dance sneakers/streetwear, explicit anti-swoosh/three-stripe language

business.fire_movement.original_defect: final_hygiene_test_8_v1: big 'Life Map' title fixed, but small readable sticky-note labels 'Side Hustles' and 'Investing' persisted.

arts.comedy_writing.original_defect: Batch-1 and both remediation rounds (three times unchanged): book spine clearly reads 'THESAURUS'.

arts.calligraphy.original_defect: Batch-1 and final_hygiene_test_8_v1 (both): background hanging scroll and framed wall pieces show large, legible-looking individual kanji-style characters beyond the semantically-necessary active brushstroke.

arts.zine_making.original_defect: final_hygiene_test_8_v1: primary zine prop fixed (no more 'ZINE' wordmark), but background wall poster/flyer collage still showed legible-looking gig-poster-style text fragments.

arts.hip_hop_dance.original_defect: final_hygiene_test_8_v1: graffiti text fully fixed, but a new brand/trademark finding surfaced - a pale swoosh-like mark on the sneaker and a three-stripe pattern on a jacket sleeve.

avoided: no substitutions, no easy controls, no extra cards - exactly these 5 exact IDs per the task instruction

final_green_gate.business.fire_movement: no readable sticky-note labels; no readable headings/titles
final_green_gate.arts.comedy_writing: no THESAURUS; no other readable writing
final_green_gate.arts.calligraphy: no recognizable/readable real text; abstract brush marks are permitted and NOT counted as a text leak
final_green_gate.arts.zine_making: no readable hero or background text
final_green_gate.arts.hip_hop_dance: no swoosh/check-like mark; no three-stripe pattern; no brand/pseudo-brand mark; no readable graffiti
final_green_gate.note: If all five pass, classify GREEN. If one narrow hobby-specific defect remains, classify AMBER and identify only that blocker. Do not lower the gate to proceed.

decision_rule.green: GREEN means Batch 2 is now eligible for explicit user authorization - a separate user instruction is still required to actually start it.
decision_rule.amber: A narrow hobby-specific blocker remains; Batch 2 stays locked.
decision_rule.red: Not applicable at this narrow a scope; any structural failure would be reported as AMBER with the specific blocker named.
